findings.summary: The brief requires checking publication status with 'the same not-draft-and-not-future-dated-in-Brisbane-time rule the rest of the site applies.' The site's actual rule, apps/web/src/utils/data-utils.ts isPublished(), is `!data.draft && (import.meta.env.DEV || publishDate <= now+offset)` — it treats every non-draft post as published while running `astro dev`, which is how index/tag/RSS pages already behave locally. This plugin's isPublished() (lines 32-37) omits the DEV branch entirely, so during local dev a non-draft, future-dated post shows normally in listings and renders at its own URL, but any inline link to it from another post gets silently downgraded to plain text — a direct behavioral divergence from 'the rest of the site' for exactly the scheduled-post scenario the feature targets. No content in the repo currently exercises this (all non-draft posts are already past-dated), so it hasn't shipped a visible bug yet, but it will as soon as a future-dated non-draft post is cross-linked and previewed with `pnpm dev`.

findings.summary: loadArticles() does a fresh readdirSync + readFileSync-per-article on every single document the remark pipeline transforms (every article, project, and page .md/.mdx file, since markdown.remarkPlugins applies site-wide), rather than computing the article map once per build and reusing it. Harmless at 17 articles but is an easy, non-invasive win (a module-level memo or lazy singleton) that avoids O(n²) disk reads as content grows.

findings.summary: Only mdast nodes with type === 'link' (inline `[text](/blog/slug)` syntax) are checked. Reference-style links (`[text][1]` + a separate `definition` node) produce a `linkReference` node, and raw `<a href="/blog/...">` HTML/JSX produces an `html`/`mdxJsxTextElement` node — neither matches, so a draft/future link written either way would ship live with no warning, silently defeating the feature's purpose for that link. No article currently uses either style (verified by grep), so this is latent, not an active failure.

findings.summary: Implementer report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff adds no test file and the repo has no test runner configured anywhere (no vitest/jest config, no *.test.*/*.spec.* files in the whole monorepo). The claim isn't corroborated by the diff. I manually exercised the plugin against a synthetic mdast tree (draft-link stripped + warning logged correctly, published link preserved) and it behaves correctly for the core case, so this doesn't indicate a code defect — just an unsubstantiated report claim.
